name: Procedural Volumetric Cloud Rendering
definition: A real-time volumetric cloud rendering system implemented in Unity 2022.3, inspired by Horizon: Zero Dawn, using Perlin-Worley noise for density generation and raymarching for volume integration.
summary: Procedural Volumetric Cloud Rendering is a real-time technique using procedural noise and multiple-scattering approximations to generate physically plausible, dynamically moving cloudscapes without pre-baked textures.
